name: Pescao
author: FranjeGueje
description: Frame generation and scaling profiles for MAKO Renderer: edit them and choose one per game.

items.label: Prepare frame generation
items.hint: Sets frame generation up when the game starts. Turn off only to use scaling alone. Applies on the next launch.

items.label: Generate frames
items.hint: Turns generation on or off live; off is MAKO's 0x position, without losing the rest of the profile.

items.label: Model
items.hint: MAKO FG is MAKO's own and needs nothing else. LSFG is Lossless Scaling's and needs your own copy of it (Lossless.dll); MAKO falls back to MAKO FG if it can't load it. Applies on the next launch.

items.label: MAKO FG mode
items.hint: How often motion is solved: every real frame pair (Quality), one in two (Balanced), one in three (Performance) or one in four (Extra performance). Lighter modes save GPU time but can show more artifacts in fast motion. With Ultra performance on, only Performance and Extra performance. Applies live.

items.label: LSFG Performance
items.hint: On: LSFG Performance, the lighter Lossless Scaling model (less GPU work, can add ghosting). Off: LSFG Quality. Set by Ultra performance while that's on. Applies live.

items.label: Adaptive
items.hint: Varies the generated frames toward a target frame rate instead of a fixed multiplier.

items.label: Multiplier
items.hint: Total frames shown per real frame: 2 doubles the frame rate. Start with 2 and go up only if it helps.

items.label: Base FPS cap
items.hint: Caps the game's real frames; 0 is off. Set by Steady base cap while that's on. Setting a cap turns Dynamic cadence recovery off.

items.label: Gamescope VRR
items.hint: Follow Steam leaves VRR alone. On/Off request it while this game runs, on displays that support VRR.

items.label: Target FPS
items.hint: Output frame rate to aim for. A goal, not a promise: an unreachable target is simply missed. With Match display refresh rate on, only used if the refresh rate can't be read.

items.label: Match display refresh rate
items.hint: Aims at the display's current refresh rate instead of Target FPS, and follows it when it changes during play.

items.label: Max multiplier
items.hint: The most frames Adaptive may show per real frame.

items.label: Steady base cap
items.hint: Caps real frames at half the target for an even cadence. Can cost responsiveness. Turns Dynamic cadence recovery off.

items.label: Real frame priority
items.hint: With Steady base cap off (fractional Adaptive): keeps more real frames in the mix. Higher can lower latency and artifacts, but pacing may feel less even. Turns Dynamic cadence recovery off.

items.label: Smooth cadence
items.hint: Favours an even, validated delivery pattern. Compare on and off in each game.

items.label: Scaling
items.hint: Upscales the game's image. Applies on the next launch.

items.label: Method
items.hint: MAKO Scaler needs nothing else. LS1 needs Lossless.dll (falls back to MAKO Scaler if it fails). Ultra performance uses MAKO Scaler. Applies live.

items.label: Scale factor
items.hint: Output size over source size, per side: 1.5 turns 720p into 1080p. Lower the in-game resolution to match.

items.label: Sharpness
items.hint: Sharpening strength after scaling.

items.label: Quality supersampling
items.hint: Lets variable Gamescope surfaces render beyond the display before downsampling.

items.label: Flow scale
items.hint: Resolution used to estimate motion. Lower is lighter on the GPU but less precise. Applies live.

items.label: Ultra performance
items.hint: A preset, locked while it's on: flow scale 0.6 and at least the Performance mode with MAKO FG, flow scale 0.7 and LSFG Performance with LSFG, and MAKO Scaler when scaling. FP16 follows the global Allow FP16. Turning it off puts flow scale back to 0.8 and LSFG Quality. Applies on the next launch.

items.label: GPU headroom
items.hint: Lowers real frames to keep this much GPU spare (10% aims at about 90% use). Needs an AMD GPU. May reduce stutter, but can add input lag. Turns Dynamic cadence recovery off.

items.label: GPU
items.hint: GPU name, vendor:device id or PCI bus id. Leave empty to let MAKO choose. Applies on the next launch.

items.label: HDR quality
items.hint: Only used with HDR on (Manage › Launcher). Quality keeps full precision; Balanced uses compact buffers; Performance also lowers HDR10 motion detail. Output resolution stays the same.

items.label: Pause at refresh rate
items.hint: Pauses generation when Gamescope reports a refresh rate at or below this; 0 is off.

items.label: Dynamic cadence recovery
items.hint: Rechecks the game's native cadence, for games that change frame rate between menus and play. Turning it on clears the real-frame caps (Base FPS cap, Steady base cap, Real frame priority) and GPU headroom.

items.label: Recovery interval
items.hint: How often the cadence is rechecked.

items.label: Game swapchain images
items.hint: Keeps the game's own swapchain image count. Only for games that won't start otherwise. Applies on the next launch.

items.label: Mailbox presentation
items.hint: Presents generated frames through mailbox instead of FIFO. Only for games that hang or fail with frame generation: a newer frame can replace a generated one, so smoothness and pacing may suffer. Applies on the next launch.

global.label: Allow FP16
global.hint: Lets frame generation and MAKO Scaler use half precision where the model and the GPU support it; off uses full precision (FP32). LS1 always uses FP32. Applies on the next launch.

global.label: Lossless.dll path
global.hint: Where Lossless.dll is. Leave empty to let MAKO find it. Only LSFG and LS1 need it; MAKO FG, MAKO Scaler and shaders don't. Applies on the next launch.

launcher.label: Disable Steam overlay
launcher.hint: May reduce stutter. Turns off Steam's in-game overlay and its FPS counter in Desktop Mode and may affect Steam Input; Gaming Mode menus and the performance overlay still work. All games started with mako-launch, from their next start.

launcher.label: HDR (experimental)
launcher.hint: For external HDR displays; HDR must also be on in the game. Each profile's HDR quality is under its HDR section. All games started with mako-launch, from their next start.

launcher.label: Zink
launcher.hint: Runs OpenGL games through Vulkan (Mesa's Zink), for OpenGL games that need it. All games started with mako-launch, from their next start.

launcher.label: Force ALSA audio
launcher.hint: Uses ALSA audio in SDL and Wine/Proton instead of PulseAudio. May help a game's audio or Zink. All games started with mako-launch, from their next start.
